Tap and hold in the box → Paste, then tap Make my puzzles.

1 In your AI chat, click Copy on the box with your puzzles. No box? Send the AI: Put all puzzles in one code block. No AI? Use the puzzle form below.
2 Paste it below and click Make my puzzles.
3 Check the pages, then click Print / Save as PDF. Keep the answer key for yourself.
Printing tip: choose Actual size / 100% and print in colour. To get a PDF file, pick Save as PDF as the printer. Your text stays on this computer: nothing is uploaded.
For personal use in your home, at your own party, office party or family gathering, or in one classroom; please don't resell or share the files.

Puzzle form: no AI needed

Type an emoji row and its answer (and a hint if you like). Tap emoji in the palette to add them to the row you are typing in. We print the puzzle sheets and an answer key. A carol puzzle spells the title only: never type the words of a song.

Idea starters

Tap one to add it to the next empty row, then change it to your own.
